Hello, I’m Rainy

I’m a Postdoc at Stanford GSE studying early reading and literacy development. My advisors are Rebecca Silverman and Jason Yeatman.

Prior to Stanford, I was a postdoctoral researcher (advisor: Elika Bergelson) at Harvard LDS working on early language environment and acquisition, since January 2025.

I obtained my DPhil in Experimental Psychology at the University of Oxford, where I focused on the children’s emotion words in written language. I was advised by Kate Nation and Robert Hepach.

Before that, I completed my BSc in Psychology at University College London.

🔬 Research Interests

  • Language development
  • Emotion words
  • Experimental and corpus methods
